tool.name: sumatrapdf_new_window
tool.description: Open a new, empty SumatraPDF main window (same as File > New Window / Ctrl+N) by calling the app's internal CreateAndShowMainWindow(nullptr) in-process on the GUI thread. Takes no arguments; returns the new frame HWND and the window count before/after.

resolution.strategy: module base + RVA 0x1a39b8, guarded by PE TimeDateStamp 0x69d3aabe and 18 entry bytes
resolution.function: CreateAndShowMainWindow(SessionData* data) (src/SumatraPDF.cpp:1603), called with data = nullptr
resolution.calling_convention: win64 (RCX = SessionData* = nullptr; RAX = MainWindow* or nullptr)
resolution.thread_affinity: GUI thread owning the existing SUMATRA_PDF_FRAME windows (run via WAM.onUiThread inside DispatchMessageW)
resolution.this_or_state_resolution: Free function, no this. Implicit globals validated before the call: gGlobalPrefs (RVA 0x10eb6e8) non-null with windowState in 0..4; gWindows Vec (RVA 0x10dae50) with 1<=len<=cap and every MainWindow* having hwndFrame (+0x10) = a SUMATRA_PDF_FRAME of this process and hwndCanvas (+0x18) = SUMATRA_PDF_CANVAS. After the call: gWindows len +1 and the last entry == returned pointer.

postcondition.why: CreateMainWindow creates one new top-level SUMATRA_PDF_FRAME and CreateAndShowMainWindow shows it (SW_SHOW / SW_MAXIMIZE).
The number of visible top-level windows of the process changes: the new frame appears (observed +2, because a toolbar tooltip window of the new frame also becomes visible).
